title.narrative: Assam Urban Infrastructure Investment Program - Tranche 1

description.narrative: The MFF adopts a strategic and integrated approach to sustainable urban environmental improvement in Guwahati and Dibrugarh, Assam, including water supply, wastewater treatment, solid waste management, and drainage. Project 1 will support MFF management and implementation, including equipment, logistics, and the consultants to assist the program management unit (PMU) in detailed design, construction supervision, and related training and capacity building. Project 1 will provide improved and sustainable urban services at the standards set by the Government in the cities of Guwahati and Dibrugarh in Assam through the delivery of improved water supply, solid waste management (SWM), and drainage infrastructure.

title.narrative: Loan 2806: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 25 Nov 2024
Loan 3624: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 25 Nov 2024
Progress Toward Outcome: 2 works contracts, 1 for construction of storage reservoirs and 1 for transmission mains were awarded in 2016 and are completed in September 2021.
Some results are in the Initial Environmental Examination | Sep 2021: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/42265/42265-023-iee-en_1.pdf
Some results are in the Resettlement Plans | Sep 2021: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/42265/42265-023-rp-en_1.pdf
Some results are in the Safeguards Due Diligence Reports | Oct 2021: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/42265/42265-023-sddr-en_1.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Feb 2022: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/42265/42265-023-smr-en_14.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: Out of total 6 works contracts, 2 water supply contracts in Guwahati, 1 drainage contract and 3 contracts for solid waste management (SWM) in Dibrugarh were awarded. In addition, there was one goods package for supplying equipment for SWM plant in Dibrugarh, which has 6 lots. Except Dibrugarh drainage works (90% Progress) all the awarded works have been completed.
One Contract of drainage awarded under L3624 is ongoing and current progress is 89%.
Tenders and Contracts Awarded: https://www.adb.org/projects/42265-023/main#project-tenders
